changes.zh: 先王以神武聖略，保全一方，威以殄奸，德以懷遠，故九州之人，塞表殊類，繈負萬里，若赤子之歸慈父，流人之多舊土十倍有餘，人殷地狹，故無田者十有四焉。

before.literal: The former king, by divine martial sage strategy, preserved one region; by might he destroyed traitors and by virtue he won the distant; therefore people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li, like infants returning to a loving father; the displaced exceeded the old population more than tenfold, the people were many and the land narrow, so those without fields were fourteen in ten.
before.idiomatic: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and fourteen in ten had no fields.
before.en: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and fourteen in ten had no fields.

after.literal: The former king, by divine martial sage strategy, preserved one region; by might he destroyed traitors and by virtue he won the distant; therefore people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li, like infants returning to a loving father; the displaced exceeded the old population more than tenfold, the people were many and the land narrow, so those without fields were four in ten.
after.idiomatic: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and four in ten had no fields.
after.en: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and four in ten had no fields.

changes.reason: 無田者十有四焉 means four in ten (cf. ZZTJ parallel 什有三四), not fourteen in ten; both literal and idiomatic (and the package en) misread 十有四.

changes.zh: 且水旱之厄，堯、湯所不免，王者宜浚治溝澮，循鄭白、西門、史起溉灌之法，旱則決溝為雨，水則入於溝瀆，上無《雲漢》之憂，下無昏墊之患。

before.literal: Moreover flood and drought are misfortunes Yao and Tang did not escape; a king ought to dredge and maintain canals and ditches, follow the irrigation methods of Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; in drought open ditches as rain, in flood send water into channels; above no worry like the "Cloudy Han," below no trouble of mire and flood.
before.idiomatic: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation like Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; drought is eased by channels and flood by drainage, ending worry above and mire below.
before.en: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation like Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; drought is eased by channels and flood by drainage, ending worry above and mire below.

after.literal: Moreover flood and drought are misfortunes Yao and Tang did not escape; a king ought to dredge and maintain canals and ditches, following the Zheng and Bai canals and the irrigation methods of Ximen and Shi Qi; in drought open ditches as rain, in flood send water into channels; above no worry like the "Cloudy Han," below no trouble of mire and flood.
after.idiomatic: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation after the Zheng and Bai canals and the methods of Ximen and Shi Qi; drought is eased by channels and flood by drainage, ending worry above and mire below.
after.en: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation after the Zheng and Bai canals and the methods of Ximen and Shi Qi; drought is eased by channels and flood by drainage, ending worry above and mire below.

changes.reason: 鄭白 are the Zheng Guo and Bai canals, not a person ‘Zheng Bai’ parallel to Ximen and Shi Qi; all three English fields make that definite mistranslation.
